content: परिभू €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To defeat, subdue, conquer, overcome; (hence) to surpass, excel; लग्नद्विरेफं परिभूय पद्मम् <ls>Ku. 7. 16</ls>; <ls>R. 10. 35</ls>. .²2 To despise, slight, treat with contempt, disrespect, insult; नित्यं परिभवेच्छ्वश्रूम् <ls>Mb. 13. 93. 33</ls>; मा मां महात्मन् परिभूः <ls>Bk. 1. 22</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">4. 37</ls>. .²3 To injure, destroy, ruin. .²4 To afflict, grieve. .²5 To humiliate, disgrace. .²6 To disappear. .²7 <ab>Ved.</ab> To surround, encircle. .²8 To go or fly round. .²9 To accompany. .²10 To take care of. .²11 To guide, govern. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To think of, reflect on, meditate, contemplate; तामेतां परिभावयन्त्वभिनयैर्विन्यस्तरूपां बुधाः <ls>U. 7. 20</ls>. मुक्तात्मभिः स्वहृदये परिभाविताय ज्ञानात्मने भगवते नम ईश्वराय <ls>Bhāg. 8. 3. 18</ls>. .²2 To contain, include. .²3 To make known. .²4 To surpass, exceed. .²5 To soak, saturate. .²6 To concentrate, to make cohesive; एवमेवेन्द्रियग्रामं शनैः संपरिभावयेत् <ls>Mb. 12. 195. 19</ls>. See परिभावन.
